Find diagnostic markers between two reference groups

Source: R/markers.R
diagnostic_markers.Rd

Keeps SNPs that are nearly fixed for different alleles in two reference groups of (presumed) pure animals: at most threshold frequency in one group and at least 1 - threshold in the other. With locus, only the first such SNP per locus is kept, so markers are effectively unlinked.

Usage

diagnostic_markers(geno, groups, ref1, ref2, threshold = 0.01, locus = NULL)

Arguments

geno

Genotype matrix, animals in rows and SNPs in columns, counting copies of one allele (0, 1, 2; NA for missing).

groups

Group label of each animal.

ref1, ref2

Labels of the two reference groups. ref2 defines species 2, whose alleles the hybrid index counts.

threshold

Largest frequency allowed for the minor allele in each reference group (0.01 keeps markers within 1% of fixation).

locus

Optional locus name of each SNP.

Value

A data.frame with one row per marker: column (index in geno), name, flip (TRUE when the counted allele belongs to species 1), and the counted allele's frequency in each reference group (freq1, freq2).

Examples

ex <- hybridclock_example()
mk <- diagnostic_markers(ex$genotypes, ex$groups, "species1", "species2", locus = ex$locus)
nrow(mk)
#> [1] 314
